name: node_degree
author: ns26z168
description: Counts a node's connections in a graph. For directed graphs it returns incoming, outgoing, and total degree; for undirected graphs it returns the degree. Use it to answer questions about direct routes, links, or neighbours of a specific node. The result includes the node id and human-readable label.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Id of the node whose connections should be counted.
